capabilities: Render compatible Fileclass fields as Meta Bind controls in the editor
Trigger FCMB[field] controls via a persistent multi-select prompt
Toggle multiple options with clicks or keyboard without closing the prompt
Follow Obsidian's native Prompt/Suggestion UI, theming, and highlight styles
Refresh rendered controls when definitions or frontmatter change
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); v0.1.6 changelog notes that only the multi-select UI was reworked while interaction rules from v0.1.4 are kept. Makes no network requests or telemetry and is MIT licensed.
intentEvidence: After installing Fileclass and Meta Bind, enable this plugin and open a note that uses Fileclass fields.
problem: Fileclass fields are edited as plain frontmatter; there is no built-in way to turn them into in-editor input controls bound to Meta Bind.

relations.evidence: Compatible fields are rendered as Meta Bind controls in the editor.
It does not bundle Fileclass, Meta Bind, or CodeMirror; those integrations use the APIs exposed by the installed host plugins

summary: Bridge plugin that renders Fileclass fields as Meta Bind input controls in notes, with a native-style persistent multi-select prompt.
